# Execute commands and inspect an exec.Command call in Go source.
exec echo 'Hello from scripttest'
stdout 'Hello'
exec mcpdiff --help
stderr 'Usage'
exec go run demo/analyzer.go
stdout 'Found exec.Command'
stdout 'Cannot determine target binary statically'

-- demo/analyzer.go --
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "go/ast"
    "go/parser"
    "go/token"
)

func main() {
    const src = `package main
import "os/exec"
func runTest() {
    cmd := exec.Command("mcpdiff", "--help")
    cmd.Run()
}`
    node, err := parser.ParseFile(token.NewFileSet(), "", src, 0)
    if err != nil {
        panic(err)
    }
    ast.Inspect(node, func(n ast.Node) bool {
        if call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
            if sel, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.Sel.Name == "Command" {
                fmt.Println("Found exec.Command call")
                fmt.Println("Cannot determine target binary statically")
            }
        }
        return true
    })
}
